This '''tentacled creature''' was a creature of an unknown [[Species/Legends|species]] kept by [[Soopan]] in his [[Descent Shopping Mall|shopping mall]]. It was described has having a bad attitude. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] fought this tentacled creature during his [[raid on the Descent Shopping Mall]].
